structural.message: policyState target 'strict' is outside the bound blueprint's closed set (default, default, focus)
structural.structuralFinding: F11 (pre-alpha3 W1 fix-A, 3b7039e8, an ancestor of this base): the policyState closed set is the ADDRESSED team's BOUND Blueprint and a BOUND ref never consults the host boot Blueprint. Demonstrated on one team bound to team.prb-ps: the bound-only 'focus' COMMITTED (entryId ps-focus-0) although the boot blueprint (team.mpr-anchor: ["strict"]) does not declare it; the boot-only 'strict' was rejected POLICY_STATE_UNKNOWN reporting the bound set [default, focus]; the rejection left the durable store byte-invariant (ledger high-water 63, 3 override record(s), T-PS transitions ["ps-focus-0"]). Supersedes the 10add920-era boot-blueprint oracle. Sources: packages/runtime/src/plugin/s6-remote.ts (policyState.read precheck + switchState, F11), governance service closed-set check, bound-blueprint.ts.
